statusAtRegistration: Prediction recorded; new-cohort results pending; no new-cohort execution performed by the assistant during preparation

studentPrediction.metric: Mean examined nodes across all 30 maps at budget 300
studentPrediction.context: Elicited after viewing and interpreting the earlier cohort; a new-cohort pre-run expectation, not a blind forecast about the earlier study. No separate prediction of success count or route length was supplied.

assistantProposedDesign.primaryComparison: Mean FIFO examined nodes minus mean closer-goal examined nodes over all 30 maps; positive difference supports the stated expectation for this cohort.
assistantProposedDesign.controls: Same generated and accepted seed list, grid dimensions, endpoints, density, budget, movement, costs, heuristic, neighbor order, goal handling and algorithm implementation. Only the equal-f tie rule differs.
assistantProposedDesign.sampling: Use the existing benchmark reachable-only rejection sample: candidate seeds start at base seed + 1. Retain accepted and rejected seed accounting on validation. Do not replace this cohort after seeing results.
secondaryChecks: Success counts and denominator for each rule; retain failures capped at budget.
Mean moves over each successful subset, with denominators; compare lengths directly on common successes.
Validate paths and reference lengths when reconstructing recorded rows.
Check exact accepted-seed matching between exported files and unchanged Greedy rows.
assistantProposedDesign.retention: Save both browser JSON files with configuration metadata. Preserve downloaded bytes and add separate AI validation/provenance records. Record guided user readings separately from file verification.

seedSeparation.note: Disjoint seed identifiers do not prove statistically independent or unique map layouts.

interpretationLimits: One additional fixed-seed reachable-only cohort; not universal superiority.
If either rule has failures, all-map expansion means are budget-capped and are not uncensored completion-time estimates.
Examined-node counts are not elapsed runtime, energy or physical robot performance.
Record negative or inconclusive results without changing seeds or dropping maps.
